{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}

'''Malcolm Ludvigsen''' (born 14 February 1946) is a British [[mathematician]] and [[En plein air|plein air]] painter. He is a former research fellow and visiting lecturer in mathematics at the [[University of York]] and the author of a book on [[general relativity]].<ref>{{cite book |last=Ludvigsen |first=Malcolm |date=1999 |title=General Relativity: A Geometric Approach |location=Cambridge |publisher=Cambridge University Press |isbn=9780521630191}}</ref><ref>Review of ''General Relativity'' by A. F. Rañada (1999), ''European Journal of Physics'' 20 (6): 524, {{doi|10.1088/0143-0807/20/6/503}}.</ref><ref>Review of ''General Relativity'' by Sergei F. Shandarin (2000), ''Physics Today'' 53 (6): 60–62, {{doi|10.1063/1.1306377}}, {{bibcode|2000PhT....53f..60S}}.</ref><ref>Review of ''General Relativity'' by Graham S. Hall (2001), ''General Relativity and Gravitation'' 33 (4): 713–714, {{doi|10.1023/A:1010274016770}}.</ref> Many of his paintings depict the beaches of the [[Yorkshire]] coast.<ref>{{cite web |last=Hutchinson |first=Charles |date=18 April 2008 |title=Mostly Seaside En Plein-Air, Malcolm Ludvigsen, Treasurer's House, York, until May 8 |url=https://www.yorkpress.co.uk/leisure/exhibitions/2208213.mostly-seaside-en-plein-air-malcolm-ludvigsen-treasurers-house-york-until-may-8/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181224220158/https://www.yorkpress.co.uk/leisure/exhibitions/2208213.mostly-seaside-en-plein-air-malcolm-ludvigsen-treasurers-house-york-until-may-8/ |archive-date=24 December 2018 |website=The Press |location=York}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|title=Artist Malcolm has an eye for figures|url=http://www.thescarboroughnews.co.uk/news/artist-malcolm-has-an-eye-for-figures-1-1464824|newspaper=The Scarborough News|date=November 23, 2009|access-date=September 18, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304060744/http://www.thescarboroughnews.co.uk/news/artist-malcolm-has-an-eye-for-figures-1-1464824|archive-date=March 4, 2016|url-status=dead}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|title=Yorkshire's great outdoors inspire Malcolm's evocative landscapes|newspaper=Hull Daily Mail|url=http://www.thisishullandeastriding.co.uk/Great-outdoors-inspire-artist/story-11979783-detail/story.html|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130918223716/http://www.thisishullandeastriding.co.uk/Great-outdoors-inspire-artist/story-11979783-detail/story.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 September 2013|date=August 9, 2010}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|title=Ludvigsen at the Shore|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/daniel-maidman/malcolm-ludvigsen-bridlington_b_2331235.html|first=Daniel|last=Maidman|newspaper=[[Huffington Post]]|date=December 21, 2012}}.</ref>
